paper_title: Constructing High-Efficiency Orange-Red Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence Polymers by Excited State Energy Levels Regulation via Backbone Engineering
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Funct Materials - 2023 - Hua - Constructing High‐Efficiency Orange‐Red Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence/auto/Adv Funct Materials - 2023 - Hua - Constructing High‐Efficiency Orange‐Red Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence.md

knowledge_points.content: A series of orange-red TADF polymers were synthesized using dibenzothiophene (DBT) and carbazole (Cz) units as a joint backbone, with naphthalimide-dimethylacridine (NAI-DMAc) as the TADF emitting unit.
knowledge_points.evidence: Herein, a series of orange-red TADF polymers with dibenzothiophene (DBT) and carbazole (Cz) units as joint backbones are synthesized... High-efficiency naphthalimide-dimethylacridine (NAI-DMAc) are chosen as TADF units.

knowledge_points.content: The optimal polymer, pNAI3705, achieves a maximum external quantum efficiency (EQEmax) of 20.16% and maintains an EQE of 10.61% at a luminance of 500 cd/m².
knowledge_points.evidence: Consequently, pNAI3705 based organic light-emitting diodes reach a maximum external quantum efficiency of 20.16% , and maintain 10.61% at 500 cd m-2.

knowledge_points.content: The pNAI3705 polymer exhibits a photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) of 60% and a reverse intersystem crossing rate (kRISC) of 7.20 × 10^5 s⁻¹.
knowledge_points.evidence: Among them, pNAI3705 with 5% TADF units presents the outstanding PLQY of 60% and kRISC of 7.20 × 10^5 s-1.

knowledge_points.content: The connection position of DBT units significantly affects the HOMO distribution; the pNAI37 series (3,7-linked) shows a more extended HOMO across the backbone compared to the more twisted and localized HOMO in the pNAI28 series (2,8-linked).
knowledge_points.evidence: HOMO of pNAI37 is more widely stretched on the backbones... By contrast, HOMO of pNAI28 is hardly distributed on the carbazole units... the sulfur atom has a significant contribution to HOMO for pNAI28.

knowledge_points.content: The pNAI37 series facilitates a more efficient reverse intersystem crossing (RISC) process because the energy gap between the singlet charge transfer state (¹CT) and the localized triplet state (³LE) is smaller than in the pNAI28 series.
knowledge_points.evidence: the pNAI37 series demonstrate a smaller difference between 1CT and 3LE energy levels (ΔE1CT-3LE) than the pNAI28 series... Because 3LE state can act as a mediator, which can help excitons to spin flip from triplet to singlet state.

knowledge_points.content: For optimized device performance, 10 wt% of the TADF polymer was doped into a 9H-carbazole-3-carbonitrile (mCP-CN) host to balance carrier injection and transport.
knowledge_points.evidence: Consequently, 10 wt. % emitters were doped into mCP-CN host to balance the hole-electron injection and transport.

knowledge_points.content: The thermally activated nature of the delayed fluorescence was confirmed by temperature-dependent transient photoluminescence decay, showing an increase in kRISC from 1.44 × 10^5 s⁻¹ at 77 K to 7.20 × 10^5 s⁻¹ at 300 K for pNAI3705.
knowledge_points.evidence: Taking pNAI3705 as an example, the kRISC reduces from 7.20 × 10^5 to 1.44 × 10^5 s-1 as the temperature decreases from 300 to 77 K.

knowledge_points.content: The solution-processed OLED architecture used in this study is ITO / PEDOT:PSS (30 nm) / Doped Emitter (40 nm) / TmPyPB (60-70 nm) / LiF (0.9 nm) / Al (130 nm).
knowledge_points.evidence: The solution-processed OLEDs are shown in Figure 5a with the configuration of indium tin oxide (ITO)/poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene): poly(styrenesulfonate) (PSS: PEDOT) (30 nm)/the doped emitters (40 nm)/1,3,5-tri[(3-pyridyl)-phen-3-yl] benzene (TmPyPB) (60 nm...)/lithium fluoride (LiF) (0.9 nm)/aluminum (Al) (130 nm).

knowledge_points.content: The stretched backbone configuration of the pNAI37 series provides a larger space occupation volume, which inhibits the aggregation-induced quenching of triplet excitons compared to the pNAI28 series.
knowledge_points.evidence: The more stretched backbones of the pNAI37 series with a larger space occupation volume can inhibit the aggregation between polymer chains... the pNAI37 series represent a higher PLQY... effectively inhibit the aggregation-induced quenching of triplet excitons.

knowledge_points.content: The TADF polymers exhibit high thermal stability with decomposition temperatures (Td) exceeding 400 °C and glass transition temperatures (Tg) ranging from 90 to 156 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: The glass transition temperatures (Tgs) of these polymers are in the range of 90-156 °C... The decomposition temperatures are over 400 °C.

knowledge_points.content: DFT calculations using the B3LYP/6-31 G(d,p) level revealed that the LUMO levels of pNAI37 and pNAI28 are -2.55 eV and -2.59 eV, respectively, and are primarily localized on the naphthalimide acceptor.
knowledge_points.evidence: The distributions of the highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) and lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO) were calculated by Gaussian 16 with the B3LYP 6-31 G(d,p) level... The LUMO levels of pNAI37 and pNAI28 are -2.55 eV and -2.59 eV, respectively.
